about: Gaps already known in how Ibid reads this document, each with the reason it is accepted for now. See scripts/answer-key.mjs.

accepted.reason: the parenthesis reads “(paragraphe 107)” and nothing else: a bare pinpoint, which names no authority. A reader knows it belongs to the judgment named two sentences earlier; nothing in the parenthesis says so, and a pinpoint in prose is exactly what a short form must not be allowed to reach for
